notes: MLS Assist v1.27 — write-back overhaul. Reliable verified text entry (fixes fields that silently rejected typing/paste), content-aware routing that puts each piece in the RIGHT Athena field (op/procedure note -> Procedure Documentation, ICD-10 -> Diagnoses, CPT -> Orders, insurance -> Insurance), and a mandatory patient-match safety gate that verifies the open chart is the right patient before writing.
